title: Left or right turn: the cross product is 10
caption: The cross product (4 × 3) − (1 × 2) = 10 is positive, so a → b → c turns left. It is also twice the area of triangle abc: 10/2 = 5.
alt: The path from a(0, 0) to b(4, 1) to c(2, 3), turning anticlockwise.
description: Cross product = 4 × 3 − 1 × 2 = 10, positive: a left turn (anticlockwise).
Half of it, 5, is the area of the triangle abc.
fromLesson: Positive, so a → b → c turns left (anticlockwise)
